ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Creation with Colorcpl
ruleDefinitions.description: Once executed, colorcpl.exe will copy the arbitrary file to c:\windows\system32\spool\drivers\color\

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\colorcpl\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX("\\\.icm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.gmmp$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.cdmp$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.camp$")))
